title: asset.getProperties response result
description: Properties of one asset. The values are snapshot copies, never references into engine live memory. Failure is returned as an error response with code ENGINE_ASSET_EDIT_REJECTED and an English message. Its data object contains string fields 'method' (asset.getProperties) and 'reason' (type_mismatch, out_of_range, unknown_property, unknown_asset, or save_failed), and a string 'path' field only when applicable.

logicalPath.description: Logical path of the asset whose properties are returned.

assetProperty.description: One asset property and its snapshot value.

path.description: Opaque, engine-defined location of the value. The editor must not interpret it and must return it unchanged to asset.setProperty.

valueType.description: Free-form generic type name, e.g. number, integer, string, or boolean.

value.description: Snapshot copy of the property value.

unit.description: Optional unit of the property value.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the property.
